map.新手/中级者每周 2–5% 线性递增常见且安全；老手因接近极限，常改用周期化（如: For novices and intermediates a linear increase of 2-5% per week is common and safe; advanced lifters near their limit often switch to periodization (such as 3 weeks up, 1 week deload) or undulating load. This tool uses a fixed 2.5% as an intuitive demo, and in practice you can lower it at plateaus.
map.减载周会不会把进度抵消？: Will a deload week cancel out progress?
